primary_protocol.scope: Eleven frozen primary development runs plus the completed failed-only SmolLM3 primary repair; twelve current models (five decision models and seven generative LLMs); post-evaluation roster selection. Valen, Tiny-Jev and OpenJev-0.6B restored from historical runs by author request on 2026-10-03. SmolLM3's expanded evaluation is excluded, with its historical records preserved.
primary_protocol.exact_match: Invalid responses count as incorrect. Only SmolLM3 incorporates one additional outcome per originally invalid item (1194); all 9923 valid original responses, including wrong answers, are preserved exactly. No other model's later repairs or serial runs are merged.
primary_protocol.smollm3_repair: Completed report, raw originals, one-attempt journals, frozen selection and repaired inputs verified by hashes and per-item identity; all original tokenized prompts reproduced exactly, including historical template dates. Same model, revision, greedy decoding, 32 output tokens and batching policy. No original outcome or financial record is overwritten.
primary_protocol.overall: Unweighted mean of nine benchmark-total exact-match values; includes control/unassigned questions.
primary_protocol.capabilities: Within each source, exact match over non-control questions assigned by native metadata, with ToMBench application corrected by the versioned question-target review; then unweighted mean over sources with mapped items. Capability assignments can overlap.

application_mapping.audit: Agent-assisted question-target review, not independent human validation

primary_protocol.macro_f1: Original candidate positions with positive gold support in the cell, fixed across models; other predictions still produce FN for the gold class; invalid/unsupported responses are abstentions, add FN but no answer-class FP. This is positional macro-F1, not native semantic-label F1.
primary_protocol.old_atlas_reproduction: Unchanged source/capability EM and positional macro-F1 cells for the five decision models match frozen historical metrics to <1e-9 percentage points. ToMBench application and its cross-source aggregate use the versioned question-target correction, audited separately by scripts/rebuild_application_mapping.py.
primary_protocol.figure_order: Each capability panel ranks models by its own decreasing EM; benchmark rows and appendix model columns use decreasing overall EM.
primary_protocol.missing_cells: Absent source/capability cells are omitted, not zero.

replay_scope: Primary accuracy and feedback macros from saved parsed outcomes; exported reason and capability summaries are not full raw-response replays.
